robustness.limitation: One fixed neutral start per case; deterministic world-frame pushes are not broad stochastic robustness or a walk-to-stand transition.

visual_review.method: Inspected six spaced replay frames including reset and last frame for each case.
visual_review.hold_60s: Upright standing through 60 seconds; numeric trace has continuous eligibility.
visual_review.push_x_neg: Visible fall after the pulse, consistent with physical termination at 6.96 seconds.
visual_review.video_sampling: 10 Hz saved physical states, four camera views; terminal frame is retained.

conclusion: Four checkpoints pass 60 seconds. The last two pass +X and both Y pushes; every checkpoint fails -X. No checkpoint passes the complete robustness suite.
next_experiment: Continue final weights for one 1M run, preserving 60-second episodes and reward/PPO settings. Add training-only negative-X torso pulses with randomized phase/magnitude and a 50% nominal episode probability. Keep acceptance protocol unchanged.
